'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Conrad Simmering LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Conrad Simmering]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Conrad Simering
* '''Deck name:''' QMC
* '''Username:''' Maul12555
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
